Name: Beach Bikinis
Author: evendev
Description:
Villagers will use their beach outfits and portraits if the following conditions are met:

[list]
[*]It's not winter
[*]It's sunny
[*]They are on the Pelican Town beach (building interiors such as Elliot's don't count)
[*]It's between 6 AM and 7 PM
[/list]
For some reason it's not working during the Luau event.

Currently [b]only works for vanilla NPCs that have an island beach outfit[/b]. You are welcome to suggest other characters if there's already beach sprites for them.

Manifest.Name: Beach Bikinis
